projects.description: 8-legged embodied AI system for autonomous locomotion and navigation featuring hybrid SNN–RNN architecture with self-supervised behavioral adaptation.
bullets: Architecting an 8-legged embodied AI system for autonomous locomotion and navigation through predictive sensor-error minimization, without engineered gait tables, reward functions, or simulation pre-training.

Building a hybrid SNN–RNN architecture with adaptive surprise detection, gradient-based credit assignment, prioritized failure replay, and continual-learning mechanisms for self-supervised behavioral adaptation.

projects.description: 6-DOF manipulator translating EMG/EEG-derived biosignals into robotic actions using real-time signal processing and ML-based intent recognition.
bullets: Developed a 6-DOF manipulator translating EMG/EEG-derived biosignals into robotic actions using real-time signal processing and ML-based intent recognition.
Achieved 94% intent-detection accuracy with <30 ms inference latency; integrated filtering, feature extraction, servo control, and inverse-kinematics-based manipulation.
